diff -- test/sql/pragma/profiling/test_cumulative_vacuum_time_checkpoint_latency.test_slow
@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+# name: test/sql/pragma/profiling/test_cumulative_vacuum_time_checkpoint_latency.test_slow
+# description: Test cumulative vacuum time relative to checkpoint latency
+# group: [profiling]
+
+require json
+
+require skip_reload
+
+statement ok
+SET wal_autocheckpoint = '1TB';
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA disable_checkpoint_on_shutdown;
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA disable_profiling;
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA force_compression = 'uncompressed';
+
+statement ok
+SET max_vacuum_tasks = 1000;
+
+# With one execution thread, checkpoint latency should include the vacuum task
+# time plus the checkpoint work that follows it.
+
+statement ok
+SET threads = 1;
+
+statement ok
+ATTACH '__TEST_DIR__/single_thread_vacuum_latency.db' AS single_thread_vacuum (ROW_GROUP_SIZE 2048);
+
+statement ok
+CREATE TABLE single_thread_vacuum.tbl AS
+SELECT
+	i AS id,
+	i % 1024 AS group_id,
+	repeat('payload-' || (i % 1024)::VARCHAR, 8) AS payload
+FROM range(524288) tbl(i);
+
+statement ok
+CHECKPOINT single_thread_vacuum;
+
+statement ok
+DELETE FROM single_thread_vacuum.tbl WHERE id % 2 = 0;
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA enable_profiling = 'json';
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA profiling_output = '__TEST_DIR__/single_thread_vacuum_latency.json';
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA custom_profiling_settings='{"CUMULATIVE_VACUUM_TIME": "true", "CHECKPOINT_LATENCY": "true"}';
+
+statement ok
+SET profiling_coverage='ALL';
+
+statement ok
+CHECKPOINT single_thread_vacuum;
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA disable_profiling;
+
+statement ok
+CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE single_thread_vacuum_metrics AS SELECT * FROM '__TEST_DIR__/single_thread_vacuum_latency.json';
+
+query T
+SELECT CASE
+	WHEN cumulative_vacuum_time > 0 AND cumulative_vacuum_time < checkpoint_latency THEN 'true'
+	ELSE printf('single_thread vacuum=%.9f checkpoint=%.9f', cumulative_vacuum_time, checkpoint_latency)
+	END
+FROM single_thread_vacuum_metrics;
+----
+true
+
+# With many small vacuum tasks and many execution threads, cumulative vacuum
+# time can exceed the single outer checkpoint latency because it sums the
+# elapsed time of individual vacuum tasks.
+
+statement ok
+SET threads = 100;
+
+statement ok
+ATTACH '__TEST_DIR__/parallel_vacuum_latency.db' AS parallel_vacuum (ROW_GROUP_SIZE 2048);
+
+statement ok
+CREATE TABLE parallel_vacuum.tbl AS
+SELECT
+	i AS id,
+	i % 1024 AS group_id,
+	repeat('payload-' || (i % 1024)::VARCHAR, 8) AS payload
+FROM range(524288) tbl(i);
+
+statement ok
+CHECKPOINT parallel_vacuum;
+
+statement ok
+DELETE FROM parallel_vacuum.tbl WHERE id % 2 = 0;
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA enable_profiling = 'json';
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA profiling_output = '__TEST_DIR__/parallel_vacuum_latency.json';
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA custom_profiling_settings='{"CUMULATIVE_VACUUM_TIME": "true", "CHECKPOINT_LATENCY": "true"}';
+
+statement ok
+SET profiling_coverage='ALL';
+
+statement ok
+CHECKPOINT parallel_vacuum;
+
+statement ok
+PRAGMA disable_profiling;
+
+statement ok
+CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE parallel_vacuum_metrics AS SELECT * FROM '__TEST_DIR__/parallel_vacuum_latency.json';
+
+query T
+SELECT CASE
+	WHEN cumulative_vacuum_time > checkpoint_latency THEN 'true'
+	ELSE printf('parallel vacuum=%.9f checkpoint=%.9f ratio=%.2f',
+	            cumulative_vacuum_time,
+	            checkpoint_latency,
+	            CASE WHEN checkpoint_latency = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cumulative_vacuum_time / checkpoint_latency END)
+	END
+FROM parallel_vacuum_metrics;
+----
+true

Pull request #22425: CUMULATIVE_VACUUM_TIME metric

Add a vacuum timing metric that tracks elapsed time of individual vacuum tasks as well as index rebuilding if the vacuum_rebuild_indexes setting is enabled (The latter is just a current implementation consideration, when vacuuming is supported with indexes by default, the implementation of this metric will also change, but the user facing metric remains the same). 

As a basic first pass, I didn't include vacuum planning/scheduling itself, as I think vacuum tasks and index rebuilding are the most important parts to profile, and to avoid cluttering the checkpointing code with more timers until it becomes necessary. 

With multiple threads and vacuum tasks, the vacuum time could exceed reported checkpointing latency, since we are summing the individual elapsed times for each vacuum task. Whereas if you run it with one thread, you will see closer to the "true" CPU time for the vacuum tasks.

Merged pull request #22425 from validated head commit 82e1a5bf75659c8dfb2a8b910d645c0afa23f440.

Release v1.5.3

This is a bugfix release for various issues discovered after we released v1.5.2.

Please also refer to the announcement blog post: https://duckdb.org/2026/05/20/announcing-duckdb-153

## What's Changed
* Use DB serialization compatibility for json_serialize_sql by @kryonix in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22004
* DuckLake Bump by @pdet in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22014
* fix: resolve current catalog in ADBC Ingest to avoid temp table shadowing by @eitsupi in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22020
* Fix TIMESTAMPFORMAT being ignored for TIMESTAMPTZ columns in copy to json by @DinosL in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/21992
* Provide BWC support for join filter pushdowns by @ywelsch in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22029
* Add iceberg copy function autoload by @NiclasHaderer in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22037
* Fix DISABLE_EXTENSION_LOAD by @mlafeldt in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22019
* Fix `INSERT OR REPLACE BY NAME` regression by excluding conflict columns from `SET` list by @DinosL in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22049
* Git-ignore generated extension loader by @mlafeldt in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22056
* Fix constant struct args in lateral table in-out functions by @AlfieJones in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/21827
* Avoid handling Ctrl+C during shutdown (state might be already gone) by @carlopi in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22059
* Add `DISABLE_BUILTIN_HTTPLIB` option by @carlopi in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22054
* Set `query` field for statements in `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT ...` workaround by @yan-alex in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22057
* Coorporative tasks might lead to busy spinning in `TaskExecutor::WorkOnTasks` by @NiclasHaderer in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22092
* Row group append by @evertlammerts in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22060
* Fix empty parquet child schema by @dentiny in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/22105
